tree.collapseAllDescription: Close every folder in the sidebar
tree.emptyDescription: Create a request, import a collection or paste one you copied.
tree.unreadableDescription: Their requests are hidden until the files are fixed. A file with a merge conflict comes back once you resolve it in the Git panel.
tree.noResultsDescription: No request name, URL or tag matches.
tree.deleteManyMessageFolders: Delete {{subject}}? Anything inside a deleted folder that you did not select moves up one level. This can't be undone.
tree.deleteManyFailed: Could not delete the selected items

label.colourNote: Shown on the folder icon in the sidebar and saved with the collection.
label.tagsPlaceholder: Add a tag, then press Enter
label.folderTagsNote: Folder tags apply to every request inside it, also in the sidebar search and the runner's tag filters.
label.requestTagsNote: Tags group requests across folders. Filter by them in the sidebar search and the runner.
label.tagColoursNote: A tag keeps its colour everywhere it is used. Without a choice, a colour is picked from the tag name. Tag colours are kept on this device.

tab.previewHint: Preview tab. Edit or double-click to keep it open.
tab.closeTabsMessage_one: One of these tabs has unsaved changes. Close it and discard the changes?
tab.closeTabsMessage_other: {{count}} of these tabs have unsaved changes. Close them and discard the changes?
tab.curlCopied: cURL command copied to the clipboard.
tab.noCurl: Only HTTP requests can be copied as cURL.
tab.noClipboard: The clipboard is not available here.
